status: Stage 1 plan awaiting review; no generated art
nativeBudgets: Starting canvas budgets only. Confirm native density and available clearances in the relevant stage; expand canvas, never shrink art to fit.

assets.assemblyRule: Mountains, sky, far pine silhouettes, fortress and receding arched bridge/path. No actors, gems, UI, close lanterns or fighting floor baked in. Keep lower middle quiet behind three enemies.
Quiet sky/cliff extensions cover tall and wide viewports. Maintain a fixed native scale; extend coverage instead of stretching the vista.
Weathered cold timber, steel plates and centered bolts. Separate upright pieces so snow always sits above wood. Fit the existing SharedPlayerRect; do not resize its contents.
Dark blue masonry overfills a RectMask2D inset behind the existing portrait. No gaps; do not bake the player or health bar.
Add natural upper-edge snow and sparse complete icicles. Keep snow out of the portrait interior and connectors readable. Reuse this family on later frames.
Muted blue stag banner in upper portrait negative space. Optional placement if the smallest supported portrait has clearance; never cover player, gem or HP.
Broad side-on snowy stone walking surface. Position around the existing shared feet line, with visible floor ahead and behind. Snow is clustered, not bright noise.
Separate darker blue-gray block front face below the floor and feet. Tile through the full screen width behind the masked portrait. Keep HP and weakness markers readable.
Sturdy brown timber and steel. Fit around all eight live rows with no gap between the inner rim and cells. Center clamps and rails on the same axis. Never stretch a flattened frame.
Reuse long/short snow lips and icicles from Stage 3. Add a few broad shelves, not snow around every cell. Keep the full eight-by-eight grid clear.
Large coherent alpine rock shapes with quiet dark inner edge; attach to board posts. Repeat or extend neutral rock sections on tall phones, not entire decorated strips.
Attach beams and rope to visible structural joints. Reuse for top side accents and lower corners, with fittings kept outside controls and enemy silhouettes.
Small warm windows within a cold scene. Separate lamp body from anchor for later sway; use discrete light clusters, no diffuse airbrush halo.
Muted red cloth with clear pale stag emblem, connected to a post. Later flutter stays within an expanded canvas and outside the grid.
Use a few attached accents where rock meets a post or snow shelf. Keep them away from gem colors, frame seams and HUD text; do not scatter stickers.
Quiet cold masonry behind the lower UI and screen edges. Cover every physical-screen pixel including safe-area insets without moving live controls.
One grounded snow-and-rock mass per side, joined to the side cliff. Continuous lower edge and generous overlap; no stacked floating rock islands.
Reuse earlier posts/rope/crystals. Anchor supplies in the right foundation and icy outcrop on the left. Preserve empty space behind resonance text and all shared buttons.
Sparse drifting and blinking hard-pixel sprites. No gameplay RNG or input interception; keep gems/text legible and respect pause/Reduced Motion.

assets.nativeStartingBudget: use approved still canvas plus required transparent clearance
assets.assemblyRule: Animate approved targets only. Small intermittent movement, varied phase, stable attachments and complete silhouettes. Optional drip only if it improves the scene.
